text: Sit down, sergeant, before you fall down. No, I have read the dispatch twice already, and it does not improve. We have flour for nine weeks and wood for six. That is the arithmetic. I did not make it. I only have to live inside it, like everyone else.

candidates.iron: A man in his mid-fifties with a low, quiet, precise baritone and a slight gravel of age, educated but plain, speaking slowly and economically with tired authority, a faint English West Country lilt, never raising his voice. Close to the microphone, dry room.
candidates.ash: A lean man in his fifties with a dry, cool tenor-baritone, clipped consonants, an aristocratic northern English accent worn down by years in the field, ironic and weary, a short exhale before hard words. Close to the microphone, dry room.
